purpose: Independently resolve the seven frame-2 logical families that remained revise after second-pass PRESS review, using source-supported query-surface corrections or explicit unsupported-family archives.

revision_decisions.replace_terms: Return the complete final OR-term list as revised_domain_terms_json. Preserve only source-supported terms. Remove or qualify the exact defect identified in press_notes. Evidence spans and source_title inside term_evidence_json are authorizing English title/abstract evidence.
revision_decisions.archive_unsupported: Use when the supplied direct English title/abstract evidence cannot authorize a construct-specific independent retrieval phrase under the three-block query structure, including a subtype already recoverable through a broader source-supported framework family. revised_domain_terms_json must be an empty JSON list and the rationale must identify the evidence or query-structure insufficiency.

normalization_rules: Do not insert Boolean operators into a term string; each JSON value is one complete OR alternative.
Do not retain a generic metric noun when it fails to identify the source framework or construct role.
A source title is direct English evidence only for wording actually present in that title; it does not authorize unrelated synonyms.
For damaged numeric comparisons, either retain a directly supported nonnumeric construct phrase or use an unambiguous lexical rendering whose value is exactly the source threshold.
Archive rather than force a phrase when the required framework boundary cannot be represented faithfully by the three-block OR-term schema.
Deduplicate case-insensitively and do not use target counts, model outcomes, downstream dimensions, or feature performance.
protected_fields: Every input field except revision_decision, revised_domain_terms_json, revision_rationale, and independent-review provenance must remain byte-identical and in the same row order.
